summary: The change invalidates in-flight roster responses for every provider-selection edit path, preventing stale server selections from overwriting edits, and adds focused coverage for the wiring.

evidence: static/admin.js:10121 and 10357 invalidate the load ID when selection edits occur; bulk and missing-entry actions use the same marker.
static/admin.js:10168-10176 rejects a roster completion whose load ID was invalidated, before applying server selection.
tests/admin-models-catalog.test.ts:738-752 verifies the invalidation marker and its provider-picker edit handlers.
